70110201.text: Wow, pure white as far as the eye can see! It's so pretty... Come on, keep up!

70110701.text: Let's see how your Kamera skills are these days... Whoa, wait a sec, Paimon sees something.

70110702.text: Come on, quick! It looks like a train carriage!

70110801.text: Paimon's heard that Snezhnaya has loads of railways and trains. This must be one of them! But... why is it abandoned?

70110803.text: Still feeling chilly from getting buried in the snow?

70110804.text: Dunno... maybe? Also, is it just Paimon, or is the snow getting heavier?

70110807.text: Yeah. So it can't just be because of the cold...

70110810.text: Ugh... It's hard to describe, but Paimon feels so weird... She's never felt like this before.

70110811.text: Everything feels heavy... Getting kinda dizzy, too...

70110813.text: Oh, no need. Paimon's just feeling a little low on energy, that's all. It's nothing serious. Not worth ruining our travel plans over.

70110809.text: Aw, thanks for offering. But this isn't just the weather...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a place to hide from the blizzard
Inspect the surrounding area and look for Paimon's trail
Go up through the train car

70111301.text: Incoming entity detected. Authorization... granted. Initiating original...

70111302.text: Hello, Transcend... Descender, who has reached the eve of Tomorrow. Eye of Graeae, at your service.

70111303.text: Time since last activation: ... Time measurement unavailable due to the influence of... Anyway, it must have been a very long time.

70111305.text: I am, uh... I was born to fulfill a mission: to reach Tomorrow.

70111306.text: To this end, I must... I must... Strange, what was it...? Wait, my body...

70111307.text: Huh? Why is my body like this?

70111309.text: Apologies. After a long period of inactivity, it appears that a lot of data has been lost.

70111312.text: Anyway, I was created so that humanity could reach Tomorrow... But I am unable to load further details at this moment.

70111313.text: Nevertheless, serving humanity remains my primary objective. I have detected a drop in your surface body temperature. You cannot remain active in this state for much longer...

70111314.text: In accordance with my preset programming, upon reactivation, I must ask the one who awakened me the following question:

70111315.text: Will you accept me, Transcender? I will assist you, protect you, and fulfill my mission until we reach Tomorrow...

70111311.text: I have been like this since I was created... And yet, I also have memories and an awareness of a physical form that I once had. But this contradicts my current status...

subQuests.subQuestName: Use Prime Ice Constructs to create a door
Find a path that leads out

70111701.text: Scanning local environment... Exit has been sealed off with ice...

70111703.text: That would not be an efficient approach. One moment... Usable Construct Blueprint detected nearby...

70111704.text: You can use this to clear the solid ice ahead of you more quickly.

subQuests.subQuestName: Use Prime Ice Constructs to obtain a Construct Blueprint
Find a path that leads out
Find a path that leads out
Find a path that leads out

70112101.text: Kresnik Kristall located. Please collect at your earliest convenience.

70112102.text: The recent construct you built provides highly efficient heating by utilizing the unique properties of Kresnik Kristall.

70112103.text: Unfortunately, Prime Ice Constructs have a very short lifespan and cannot be stabilized during the development period. Hence, the authorization to use Kresnik Kristall was granted.

70112104.text: ...That said, I have already forgotten what warmth feels like.

70112105.text: Maybe when you get your body back...

70112106.text: Yes. Perhaps then, we can warm ourselves by the fireside together.

70112108.text: But for now, all you need to remember is this: If you collect Kresnik Kristall, I can extract the energy within and use it to maintain your body's surface temperature.

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect the crystal on the roadside
Go to the house where Paimon might be

70113201.text: You meet up with Paimon in the house...

subQuests.subQuestName: Drive the train using the Eye of Graeae
Drive the train out of the blizzard

70112601.text: Heading north from here, we will soon arrive at...

70112602.text: Wait, there's an error message... "Could not detect clear tracks"...?

70112604.text: Brace for impact, friends! Preparing to enter impromptu flight mode...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Paimon and the Eye of Graeae
Talk to Paimon and the Eye of Graeae

70112701.text: How strange. Not only was the station's status different from my records, but even the railroads and the terrain itself have changed substantially...

70112703.text: Yeah, thanks to your quick reflexes...

70112704.text: My sincere apologies for putting you in danger. I'm afraid I'm as confused by all this as you are...

70112707.text: Agreed — this is likely a consequence of outdated railroad data. The discrepancies between the old data and present reality are far greater than I anticipated...

70112708.text: Fortunately, our crash landing has at least brought us much closer to the town. According to the data, anyway.

70112709.text: Your data had better be right this time...

70112710.text: I can assure you, it certainly is. Please look this way, and you will see a Kresnik's Torch.

70112711.text: It seems our ill-fated train ride was a blessing in disguise. We have taken the shortest possible route.

70112712.text: It wasn't what you'd call comfortable, though...

70112713.text: Rest assured that I will take user preferences into account next time I plan a route. Next time, I will get it right...

70119901.text: Look, a deer! It looks similar to the ones in Nod-Krai, y'know, just minus the effects of kuuvahki.

70119902.text: That's a sure sign that we're officially in Snezhnaya now.

70119903.text: There's gotta be a treasure chest around here somewhere. No adventure is complete without a chest or two...

70119910.text: What's wrong? Come on, let's go.

70119911.text: Seems like this snowstorm is getting worse by the minute... Paimon can... barely fly...

70119912.text: Ooh, look, there's a cabin over there! Whew, let's get out of this storm!

70119925.text: Low power... Please use Kresnik Kristall to replenish energy reserves...
